description: Payload CMS plugin for Google and Microsoft (Entra ID) OAuth on admin login, with findUserCallback, auth.verify / autoVerify, and passwordless session.
rules: Install with the app package manager, then run Payload generate:importmap so afterLogin buttons appear.
Register payloadSimpleSocialLogin in payload.config plugins; prefer env vars for clientId/clientSecret.
Leave callbackURL, loginUrl, collections, and findUserCallback unset for the simplest setup (email match on admin.user).

Default find respects collection auth.verify (ssl-error=unverified). Set collections[].autoVerify true to set only _verified true on match; ignored with custom findUserCallback or without auth.verify.
Do not auto-create users or link/unlink OAuth accounts unless the app implements that in findUserCallback.
Import public TypeScript types from payload-simple-social-login/types; client UI from payload-simple-social-login/client.
Peer dependencies: payload, @payloadcms/ui, react, and react-dom. Do not pin a separate @payloadcms/ui from the plugin.
